content: The execution successfully completed the HWPX template filling task. Key technical success factors: 1) Correctly identified the HWPX structure as a ZIP archive and located the content XML in 'Contents/section0.xml'. 2) Successfully flattened nested JSON data using dot-notation to match template placeholders. 3) Crucially, the removal of '<hp:linesegarray>' elements after text replacement prevented layout-cache corruption, which is often a point of failure in HWPX manipulation. 4) The 'in-flight' ZIP modification (copying all files while modifying only the content XML) preserved the integrity of the HWPX container.
